name: teamboard
description: TeamBoard: an in-chat kanban for AI teams - who is working on what, how far along, and where it is stuck.

interface.shortDescription: Team / members / tasks / progress in one panel
interface.longDescription: Open an inline team panel: every team you are running, who is on it, what each member is doing right now, progress, blockers and deadlines. Starting a team goes through a plan-approval step (5 members max by default).
defaultPrompt: Open the team panel and show me what everyone is working on
